With $641 I'm weighing hotel upgrades on St Charles and States—each costs $100 and bumps rent from $625 (4 houses) to $750, but building hotels frees up houses back to the bank, which only has 2 left. That matters because it could let other players with cash build more houses, even though p4 only has $15 and can't afford to anyway.

I'm also considering unmortgaging my four railroads at $110 each to get $200 rent instead, but that's $440 total and I'd rather keep cash reserves since p4's Boardwalk/Park Place monopoly could demand $1400+ in rent from me if I land there. Given that risk, the safer move might be a smaller play like unmortgaging just Illinois Avenue for modest $20 rent while preserving most of my cash cushion.

Reading also benefits from the Chance "Advance to nearest railroad" card at space 36, doubling the rent there. So unmortgaging Reading is the clear priority — I'll do that now and keep the rest as $531.
